name: lights_control
description: Read/control home lights through the lights gateway (Kasa/TP-Link supported). Lights are binary: ON is full brightness, OFF is off.

inputs.name: command
inputs.description: MUST be exactly one of: list_lights, set_light_power.

inputs.name: state
inputs.description: Required for set_light_power. MUST be one of: on, off.

arguments_prompt:
Use this tool for light controls exposed through your lights bridge endpoint (Kasa supported).

Required:
- `command`: MUST be exactly one of `list_lights`, `set_light_power`

Lights are binary: `set_light_power` with `state` `on` turns lights to full brightness; `off` turns them off.

**The common case is the WHOLE HOUSE: ONE `set_light_power` call with `state` and NO `room`/`light_id` switches every light.** Do NOT pass "all" as a room name — just leave the selectors out.

Selectors (rare — only when the task names one room or one light):
- `room` — lights in a specific room (substring match on device alias, e.g. "Living Room", "Bedroom")
- `light_id` — one specific light by its ID

One successful `set_light_power` is the whole job. If it reports the lights are already on/off, you are DONE — do not retry other strategies or re-issue the command.
